faq.q: What is the origin of Khizir?
faq.a: Khizir is associated with Arabic. Khizir is Arabic الخِضْر (al-Khiḍr), the Qur'anic figure (the 'Green One'). The source gloss 'The Hidden One' is unsupported; the name is a proper name. Same name as khadeer, khadira, khadra, khidir, khizar, khizer and khuder.
